Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CURRENT STATE / OPEN GOALS
- Three colonists: Ashkan, Bubbles, Gossmann. Cycle 11 last explicitly confirmed. No victory condition supplied. Simulation last known running; speed uncertain.
- Latest selected building: Oxygen Diffuser at CURRENT-camera (0.287,0.437). Status explicitly reports insufficient algae: 10 kg. Breathability last 70%, down from 81/77/75%. Resource-alert count fell from two buildings to one.
- LAST ACTION: clicked diffuser Errands tab (0.887,0.294), execution completed. No subsequent screenshot: contents/worker assignment are UNKNOWN.
- A dirt tile for the Microbe Musher was excavated immediately beforehand. Musher resupply/production is not directly verified; falling alert count suggests its shortage may have cleared, not proof.
- Completed: Research Station powered; Basic Farming completed; Algae Terrarium built and confirmed operating; trapped colonists escaped; supported replacement cot built and assigned to Ashkan. Remaining concerns: diffuser algae supply, sustainable oxygen/resources, downstairs CO2, musher resupply, Food Poisoning/polluted water. No new research focus selected at last inspection.

CONTROLS / UI
- Pointer without button hovers; left click selects/places. G activates Dig; Escape leaves placement. Space successfully pauses/unpauses; pause icon confirmed when highlighted. W/S move camera vertically, A left. Clicking alerts can recenter camera. World coordinates change after movement/zoom.
- Scroll over WORLD zooms; scroll over SIDE PANEL scrolls its contents. Failed zoom/panel attempts were caused by pointer location. Tab was tried for speed, but resulting speed never reliably established. Waits advance simulation but do not guarantee completion.
- Typical object Status tab (0.817,0.294), Errands (0.884,0.294); panel layout sometimes shifts (musher Status was 0.820,0.252; terrarium Errands once 0.884,0.335). Expanding supply rows sometimes showed no details; this does not prove nobody can work.
- Priority 6 commonly (0.878,0.800); deconstruction priority 9 (0.919,0.759). Global priority tool (0.803,0.931), choose 9 (0.920,0.840), then click target. Confirm displayed priority/queues. Priority 6 moved Build errands first; priority 9 helped urgent floor construction/removal.
- Menus: Base (0.028,0.938) > Tile (0.099,0.658); Power (0.100,0.938) > Wire (0.100,0.775); Oxygen (0.065,0.938) > Terrarium (0.101,0.772); Furniture (0.313,0.935) > Cot (0.045,0.774).
- Power overlay (0.794,0.094) last OFF; oxygen overlay last OFF. Show Navigation on colonist panel was enabled during rescue; later display state unknown.
- Buttons depend on object/state. Clicking (0.835,0.841) on old cot accidentally issued Disable, not Copy; clicking Enable at same position reversed it, confirmed no pending errands. Same position canceled an invalid cot blueprint. Read labels.

POWER / RESEARCH RESOLVED
- Built wires initially remained disconnected. With Wire tool, short drags between adjacent existing endpoints visibly added strands without consuming copper, despite occupied-space tooltip. Long drags left a final gap. At OLD zoom: vertical (0.549,0.548) to (0.549,0.487), lower horizontal toward station (0.373,0.548), then final short join (0.514,0.548) to (0.549,0.548) produced white continuous circuit and removed station power warning. Potential load 420 W; instantaneous 0 W did not establish failure.
- Station uses 60 W and 50 kg dirt/research point. Initially awaited 750 kg dirt. Basic Farming advanced 5/15→7→8 despite Low Dirt warning; later explicitly insufficient at 12/15. Excavation/delivery resumed research, including observed 133 kg dirt delivery. Research Complete and No Research Focus Selected appeared; Terrarium unlock confirmed completion.
- Terrain mass is not recovered inventory: 194.2 kg algae tile yielded 97.1 kg loose algae; dirt excavation showed +908 Dirt. Old copper work enabled station/wires, but old stock figures are not current inventory.

FOUNDATIONS / ACCESS / RESCUE — IMPORTANT
- Diffuser had previously suffered Max Gas Pressure in CO2 and intermittent generator attendance. Later actual blocker was Missing Tile, not pressure/power. A 200 kg sandstone foundation at OLD camera (0.583,0.548), priority 9, completed and restored confirmed 500 g/s oxygen output consuming 550 g/s algae. Battery exists; Bubbles was observed running generator. Latest blocker is now algae.
- Ashkan's old cot also reported Missing Tile. Two dirt digs below lower ladder were explicitly Unreachable although upper/lower ladder segments said Normal. Raising priority would not solve this.
- An attempted three-tile floor drag did not register clearly; single clicks worked. Bridge tile OLD (0.549,0.548) built beside diffuser. Cot occupies lower row than diffuser: attempted support at (0.514,0.548) was occupied; support blueprints were placed at (0.514,0.613) and (0.479,0.613). Colonists then reached dirt and excavated, but new support trapped Gossmann/Bubbles below floor.
- Trapped alert recentered camera. Gossmann idle, holding breath 76→70/100. Paused, enabled navigation, selected newly built RIGHT cot support at rescue-camera (0.466,0.405), queued Deconstruct via (0.835,0.799), raised to 9, resumed. After 2-second wait tile gone, pocket empty, colonists by diffuser: escape visibly restored. Do NOT rebuild this support across ladder approach/headroom. Preserve diffuser foundation and ladder opening; old cot remains unsupported.
- Main reservoir left behind thick wall; passage ABOVE waterline reaches pump at its right edge. Another reservoir visible. Preserve both barriers, equipment/station foundations, and reopened lower ladder route. Do not add floors merely to create access without checking headroom.

TERRARIUM / OXYGEN
- Built on existing platform immediately LEFT of diffuser, at an intermediate camera (0.500,0.280), not in lower pocket. Lower-pocket previews were red/occupied. Cost 400 kg dirt. Delivery progressed at priority 5; interrupted construction finished after priority 6 moved Build first for all colonists.
- Requirements observed: 30 g/s algae, 300 g/s water; produces 40 g/s oxygen, removes some CO2, produces
